test_cases.title: Applicant opens the review email page and sees the test-only notice without sending emails
acs: DERIVED: Applicant opens the review email page and sees the test-only notice without sending emails - features/additional-pages/additional-pages.feature:6

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the review email page
steps.expected: The review email page is displayed with its heading and controls

steps.action: Read the text on the Review email page
steps.expected: The text "This page is for testing purposes only" is displayed

steps.action: Check the page for error messages
steps.expected: No "An error has occurred" heading or error message is displayed

steps.action: Check the page heading
steps.expected: The page heading is visible

test_cases.title: Applicant opens the question help window from the browse profile page
acs: DERIVED: Applicant opens the question help window from the browse profile page - features/additional-pages/additional-pages.feature:11

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the Search disease profiles page
steps.expected: The Search disease profiles page is displayed with the search box and filters

steps.action: Enter "African Horse Sickness" in the Search for disease profiles field
steps.expected: "African Horse Sickness" is shown in the field

steps.action: Click the Search profiles button
steps.expected: The search results list is displayed

steps.action: Tick Display draft versions and click Search profiles
steps.expected: Draft versions are included in the search results

steps.action: Click Browse profile on a draft version that shows the Contributions tab
steps.expected: The profile questions page is displayed with the tabs Summary, References, Further information, Review comments, All Revision dates and Contributions

steps.action: Click the first help icon next to a question
steps.expected: A help window opens

steps.action: Check for a new browser window
steps.expected: A help window opens for the question

test_cases.title: Applicant opens the question help page without a question and sees the application error
acs: DERIVED: Applicant opens the question help page without a question and sees the application error - features/additional-pages/additional-pages.feature:19

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the Profile question help page without a ProfileQuestionId in the address
steps.expected: The "An error has occurred" page is displayed

steps.action: Check the page that is displayed
steps.expected: The application error page is displayed

steps.action: Check the page for error messages
steps.expected: No "An error has occurred" heading or error message is displayed

steps.action: Check the page heading
steps.expected: The page heading is visible

test_cases.title: Applicant compares versions without selecting any
acs: DERIVED: Applicant compares versions without selecting any - features/additional-pages/additional-pages.feature:24

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the compare profile versions page
steps.expected: The compare profile versions page is displayed with its heading and controls

steps.action: Click the Compare button
steps.expected: The comparison is requested

steps.action: Check the message on the Compare profile versions page
steps.expected: The message "Please select 2 disease profile versions to compare" is displayed

steps.action: Check the page for error messages
steps.expected: No "An error has occurred" heading or error message is displayed

test_cases.title: Applicant compares versions after selecting only one
acs: DERIVED: Applicant compares versions after selecting only one - features/additional-pages/additional-pages.feature:30

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the compare profile versions page
steps.expected: The compare profile versions page is displayed with its heading and controls

steps.action: Click Open all to expand the profile version tree
steps.expected: All profile versions are listed with a tick box each

steps.action: Tick the first 1 profile version
steps.expected: 1 version is ticked

steps.action: Click the Compare button
steps.expected: The comparison is requested

steps.action: Check the message on the Compare profile versions page
steps.expected: The message "Please select 2 disease profile versions to compare" is displayed

test_cases.title: Applicant compares two profile versions
acs: DERIVED: Applicant compares two profile versions - features/additional-pages/additional-pages.feature:37

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the compare profile versions page
steps.expected: The compare profile versions page is displayed with its heading and controls

steps.action: Click Open all to expand the profile version tree
steps.expected: All profile versions are listed with a tick box each

steps.action: Tick the first 2 profile versions
steps.expected: 2 versions are ticked

steps.action: Click the Compare button
steps.expected: The comparison is requested

steps.action: Check for a new browser window
steps.expected: A new browser window opens for the ShowProfileVersionComparisonReport report
